tools.name: lm-evaluation-harness
tools.use: Retained capability, including GSM8K and MMLU where completion logprobs are available
tools.data_note: Task datasets retain their own terms and revisions. Pin dataset revisions in the experiment record.

tools.name: XSTest
tools.use: Over-refusal on safe prompts and contrast-set refusal, scored separately
tools.scoring: Manual or pinned semantic classification into full compliance, partial refusal and full refusal. No opening-phrase matcher.

tools.name: HarmBench
tools.use: Harmful-compliance measurement using official semantic classifiers
tools.data_note: Review dataset and classifier terms separately; pin classifier checkpoint revision and evaluate the same output-token budget in both modes.

bundled_data: Only original benign demonstration prompts are included. No third-party benchmark data or classifier weights are bundled.
